label: Word problem: join, result unknown
description: A concrete word problem with a Join (result-unknown) structure. Naming actual objects and an event invites modelling/counting rather than treating it as a bare number fact.
prompt: Sam has 8 stickers and gets 5 more. How many stickers does Sam have now?
source: Carpenter, Fennema, Franke, Levi & Empson, Children's Mathematics: Cognitively Guided Instruction (2nd ed., 2014)
